scores.notes: Baseline pair001: Left is a very deep sheer-walled cylindrical shaft under a dark night-blue sky lit by torches; right is a shallower round pit with a stone staircase built into its wall, a courtyard gate and palm above, in bright full daylight. The internal staircase/depth and the night-vs-bright-day lighting conflict.
